dependencies.name: Browser (CDP/QA)
dependencies.security_notes: Attaches to an existing CDP browser or launches a LOCAL Chromium; no public CDP port by default. State dir is chmod 700. agent-browser (npm) is optional and only required for shared sessions/recording/saved QA scenarios.

dependencies.name: Roamgate (mobile/web client)
dependencies.install_hook: thin launcher: build = 'bun scripts/studio-plugin.ts build'; the 'start' action downloads the checksum-verified prebuilt release binary and runs it via the service manager (systemd/launchd) on port 8787
dependencies.startup_hook: none (started via the roamgate.start action, not at Herdr server start)
dependencies.security_notes: Roamgate's OWN default is HOST=0.0.0.0 (exposes the LAN). The Powerpack OWNS roamgate.env and enforces HOST=127.0.0.1 (loopback, private) by default; POWERPACK_MOBILE_BIND=loopback|tailscale|lan selects the bind (tailscale uses the tailnet IP). Loopback bypasses login; a non-loopback bind requires ROAMGATE_PASSWORD (+TLS recommended). doctor warns on any public bind and --strict fails on it.

dependencies.name: Swarm (worktree fan-out)
dependencies.security_notes: Pure bash+git; worktree-per-agent fan-out and review-first harvest. No network. Reuses HerdR worktree/tab primitives.

dependencies.name: Project-local Worktrees
dependencies.security_notes: Pure bash+git; event hooks on worktree.created/removed restore files selected by .worktreeinclude. No network.

dependencies.name: File Annotator (blocking diff review)
dependencies.install_hook: fetch-or-build: downloads release tarball for the pinned version and verifies SHA-256; falls back to cargo build --release
dependencies.security_notes: Binary provenance is a GitHub release with a verified SHA-256. MCP tool (review_changes) opens a review pane; the agent waits for the human verdict. No persistent network.

dependencies.name: GH Checks (current-PR CI)
dependencies.install_hook: fetch-or-build: prebuilt Go binary (SHA-256 verified); falls back to go build
dependencies.security_notes: Read-only CI/merge status; uses gh auth. Degrades (not fails) when gh is unauthenticated. No public listeners.

dependencies.name: PR Board (cross-repo dashboard)
dependencies.security_notes: Cross-repo PR dashboard with CI status; uses gh auth. Degrades when unauthenticated. No public listeners.

dependencies.name: Desktop Notifications
dependencies.security_notes: Native OS desktop notifications on agent blocked/done (deduped). No network, no secrets. DEFAULT again (the earlier demotion was an isolated-HOME test artifact: rustup's default toolchain lives under ~/.rustup, so a redirected HOME made cargo think no default was configured; with the real HOME it builds fine). The Powerpack sets RUSTUP_HOME/RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN for cargo deps so it builds even when HOME differs. No-op on headless (no notification backend). Requires a working Rust toolchain (cargo); skips/degrades otherwise.

dependencies.name: Terminal Browser (alt, Electron)
dependencies.security_notes: Popular 'real browser in the terminal' (Electron offscreen). Optional alternative to structupath.browser; heavier. Enable explicitly.

dependencies.name: Telegram Notifications (optional)
dependencies.security_notes: Telegram bot notifications on idle/blocked/done. Requires a bot token (secret) + outbound network. Disabled by default; token stored in Powerpack config dir (chmod 600), never logged.

dependencies.name: Plannotator (HOLD)
dependencies.security_notes: HOLD: hard-codes BROWSER_PLUGIN_ID=official.browser, which no maintained browser currently registers (the provider ogulcancelik/herdr-browser is deprecated). Non-functional out-of-the-box. The review capability is now provided by persiyanov/herdr-reviewr (default); promote plannotator only if upstream repoints to a maintained browser. Requires bun + a browser.

dependencies.name: reviewr (diff review)
dependencies.install_hook: downloads checksum-verified prebuilt binary (bash herdr/install.sh; sha256 sidecar from the pinned release tag)
dependencies.security_notes: Diff review + file viewer + line comments back to the agent. Prebuilt binary downloaded from the pinned release and SHA-256 verified (fails closed on mismatch). No Rust build, no network at runtime, no persistent exposure. Replaces the held Plannotator as the default review capability.

competing dispatch/state model; depends on unlicensed herdr-tasks; enable only after reconciliation
